intro: Barkeep Daniels tends the counter at the Lakeshire Inn, serving weary town guards, local fishermen, and visiting travelers. With the Blackrock clan raiding across the Redridge Mountains and cutting off supply routes, keeping the tavern fully stocked has become an uphill battle.

p: Behind the counter of the Lakeshire Inn stands Barkeep Daniels, pouring drinks and greeting whoever wanders in from the bridge. Lakeshire has spent months under constant pressure from gnolls and the Blackrock orcs, and the town's defenders rely on the tavern to unwind after grim patrols. Unfortunately for Daniels, the severed roads and relentless attacks have disrupted trade throughout the region. Finding himself dangerously low on liquor during a time when the town needs good cheer most, he is eager for any passing adventurer willing to fetch shipments from safer settlements.
